propositions: The bridge noun and subcommand dispatch must be established with only preview and sync verbs implemented, while all legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) remain fully functional.
The preview verb must perform read-only operations with no Jira or ticket-store mutation, and sync must mutate persistent state.
Callers cannot override the read/write distinction via --mode or --filter-local-ids flags at the bridge group level.
The Mode, MODE_CAPS rank ladder, and gated_mode reconcile-check reference must survive in mode.py without removal.
All existing consumers, workflows, scripts, library callers, and documentation must continue working at the story boundary without breakage.
User guide, CLI reference, and release notes must document only the staged surface (bridge preview and bridge sync) that actually ships, with no unimplemented placeholder verbs advertised.
